scope: Complete original spServerInit function656, including its inlined world/pool/catalog/session/handshake work. No forwarding to its own original body and no interpreter.

phases.name: resetWorldDefaults
phases.description: Ordered world component-pool headers, intrusive list sentinels, session storage and fixed arena state.

phases.name: initializeEntitySlots
phases.description: All 16,384 entity slots, exact four-record zeroing order, free-list linkage and nonzero LCG generation handles.

phases.name: initializeArenaComponents
phases.description: Replicated arena settings, player-directory and arena-count components with tracked field serialization and cache invalidation.

phases.name: initializeCatalog
phases.description: Eight spawn histograms, summoned species mass, rarity weighting, bounded drop-probability redistribution, inherited aliases, pruning and sorting.

phases.name: initializeLocalSession
phases.description: Literal UUID validation or four guarded MT19937-64 generators, stream formatting, handshake ownership, player directory and player-pool/reconnect attachment.

phases.name: flushInitializationOutput
phases.description: Intermediate and final host replies, callback-visible queue changes and buffer destruction.

phases.name: initializeServer
phases.description: Original entry point ordering, 208-byte/3312-byte stack frames, ready flags and 50ms scheduling bridge.

limitations: Explicit shared-ABI dependency functions are retained and are not counted as recovered by this module.

Full-memory equivalence is bounded to the documented inputs, states, host callbacks and forty captured-input world ticks; arbitrary corrupted memory and allocator exhaustion are not exhaustively validated.
